hints.title: Join and Group Reviews
hints.text: Combine books with reviews and group by book identifiers to compute aggregate percentages.

hints.title: Conditional Percentages
hints.text: Calculate positive and negative review percentages using conditional expressions divided by the total review count.

hints.title: Group Filtering
hints.text: Filter grouped results in the group filter clause requiring total reviews at least 5 and both percentages at least 30 percent.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```sql
SELECT 
    b.book_id,
    b.title,
    b.author,
    b.genre,
    COUNT(r.review_id) AS total_reviews,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.rating >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(r.review_id), 2) AS positive_pct,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.rating <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(r.review_id), 2) AS negative_pct
FROM Books b
JOIN Reviews r ON b.book_id = r.book_id
GROUP BY b.book_id, b.title, b.author, b.genre
HAVING COUNT(r.review_id) >= 5
   AND positive_pct >= 30.00
   AND negative_pct >= 30.00
ORDER BY b.book_id ASC;
```

complexity.notes: Hash or index join on book_id followed by aggregate filtering.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Correlated subqueries per book execute redundant scans over the reviews table.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Grouping over an indexed foreign key computes aggregates in a single scan.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use aggregation with conditional sums and filter via HAVING without repeating complex expressions.

SELECT 
    b.book_id,
    b.title,
    b.author,
    b.genre,
    COUNT(r.review_id) AS total_reviews,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.rating >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(r.review_id), 2) AS positive_pct,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.rating <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(r.review_id), 2) AS negative_pct
FROM Books b
JOIN Reviews r ON b.book_id = r.book_id
GROUP BY b.book_id, b.title, b.author, b.genre
HAVING COUNT(r.review_id) >= 5
   AND positive_pct >= 30.00
   AND negative_pct >= 30.00
ORDER BY b.book_id ASC;

SELECT 
    b.book_id,
    b.title,
    b.author,
    b.genre,
    COUNT(r.review_id) AS total_reviews,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.rating >= 4 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(r.review_id), 2) AS positive_pct,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.rating <= 2 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(r.review_id), 2) AS negative_pct
FROM Books b
JOIN Reviews r ON b.book_id = r.book_id
GROUP BY b.book_id, b.title, b.author, b.genre
HAVING COUNT(r.review_id) >= 5
   AND (SUM(CASE WHEN r.rating >= 4 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(r.review_id)) >= 30.00
   AND (SUM(CASE WHEN r.rating <= 2 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(r.review_id)) >= 30.00
ORDER BY b.book_id ASC;
